title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
# ORACLE MORNING BRIEF

Bitcoin's down two percent to 79,561—nothing catastrophic, but fear gauge sitting at 34 tells you sentiment's fragile. Overnight didn't bring surprises; Asia session quiet, no major liquidations.

**What matters today:**

Network's running smooth. Hashrate holding firm at 916 exahash. Mempool's slightly congested—94,000 transactions stacking up—but base fees at 1 sat per byte mean you're not paying a premium unless you need speed.

The real watch: We're 51 blocks from 950
